'''Eric Paquin''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 6th at [[2000 Ottawa Grand Slam]] on 20 May 2000, according to Thomas Dowling's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d779">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-21-ottawa-grand-slam-scrub-s-point-of-viewd779/ ottawa-grand-slam-scrub-s-point-of-view], DeckTech (Thomas "COTEB" Dowling, 21 May 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-21-ottawa-grand-slam-scrub-s-point-of-viewd779/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
